text: Put away your phones. It is time to begin class.[VAR 0x0114(0029)]

label: class_g_03_home_02
text: In my last class, I taught about HP restoration.[VAR 0x0114(0029)]

label: class_g_03_home_03
text: However, after class, I was asked by several of\nyou about [VAR 0xFF00(0006)]Power Points[VAR 0xFF00(0000)], commonly known as [VAR 0xFF00(0006)]PP[VAR 0xFF00(0000)].[VAR 0x0114(0029)]

label: class_g_03_home_04
text: When a Pokémon loses all of its HP, it faints and\ncan no longer battle![VAR 0x0114(0029)]

label: class_g_03_home_05
text: What, then, happens to a Pokémon when it loses\nall of its PP?[VAR 0x0114(0029)]

label: class_g_03_select_01
text: It can’t use moves

label: class_g_03_select_02
text: It won’t listen to its Trainer

label: class_g_03_select_03
text: All of its stats get lowered

label: class_g_03_home_answer_02
text:
That would certainly be a dangerous situation,
but that is not the correct answer.\c
Whether a Pokémon listens to its Trainer depends
on the number of Gym Badges the Trainer has.[VAR 0x0114(0029)]

label: class_g_03_home_answer_03
text:
That would certainly be a dangerous situation,
but that is not the correct answer.\c
That is not the sort of power we are talking
about when we talk of Power Points.[VAR 0x0114(0029)]

label: class_g_03_home_06
text: When a Pokémon runs out of PP, it can no longer\nuse its moves.[VAR 0x0114(0029)]

label: class_g_03_home_07
text: However, each move has its own store of PP, so\nyou can mitigate PP loss by using a variety of\r\nmoves rather than just one move repeatedly.[VAR 0x0114(0029)]

label: class_g_03_home_08
text: If a Pokémon loses all PP for all of its moves, it\nwill only be able to use Struggle—an action that\r\nalso damages the Pokémon that uses it.[VAR 0x0114(0029)]

label: class_g_03_home_09
text: In order to avoid this predicament, PP can be\nrestored at Pokémon Centers along with HP.[VAR 0x0114(0029)]

label: class_g_03_home_10
text: Items such as Ethers and Max Ethers can also be\nused to restore PP. Be careful not to confuse\r\nPotions with Ethers in the heat of battle![VAR 0x0114(0029)]

label: class_g_03_home_11
text: However, Ethers are not sold at shops, so you\nshould use them judiciously if you find them.[VAR 0x0114(0029)]

label: class_g_03_home_12
text:
The stronger the move, the lower its maximum PP.\c
Do not waste uses of these moves unless you wish
to quickly run out of PP. It is important to find
balance in a Pokémon’s set of moves.[VAR 0x0114(0029)]

label: class_g_03_home_13
text: As you can see, HP isn’t the only thing you must\nkeep an eye on while adventuring with Pokémon.[VAR 0x0114(0029)]

label: class_g_03_home_14
text: I hope that you will all take care to ensure that\nyour partner Pokémon can perform at their best\r\nas you each engage in the Treasure Hunt.[VAR 0x0114(0029)]

label: class_g_03_home_15
text: Our time together has come to an end for today.\nOur next meeting will be an examination day.\r\nBe sure to review well in preparation.[VAR 0x0114(0029)]
